subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Inciting Incident
description: Learn The Inciting Incident in one minute.

hook.text: Every great film has a single moment that pushes the story into motion.

buildup.text: The inciting incident disrupts the protagonist's ordinary world and forces a choice.

discovery.text: In The Matrix, it's Neo's red pill. In Jaws, it's the first shark attack.

twist.text: If the inciting incident arrives too late, audiences check their phones.

climax.text: The best inciting incidents feel inevitable in hindsight but shocking in the moment.

quiz.question: What does the inciting incident do in a screenplay?
options: Disrupts the ordinary world and forces the protagonist to act
